# ShareWillow

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `light` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, and keeps the 4 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: Trade-business incentive marketing on one light page: ivory #f7f5f1, espresso #180600 pills, lemon #faf082 accent, Mackinac display over Matter, a dark footer band, and a separate signed-out login card..

Captured 2026-11-19, signed out. Public marketing and the login form were read. Nothing was typed or submitted. Signup is a six-step password form with reCAPTCHA, so it was not filled in. Phone sign-in, payment, and the signed-in app were not entered.. Themes: light.

ShareWillow is performance pay for trade businesses. This package measures the public marketing site at www.sharewillow.com and the signed-out login at app.sharewillow.com/login. Captured on 2026-11-19 from a signed-out browser. The marketing site is light only. Desktop readings are at innerWidth 1440 and innerHeight 900, devicePixelRatio 2. A 390px pass was not taken.

No screenshot was saved. `preview_snapshot` returned "The browser is not producing screenshot frames" twice. Values come from computed styles and declared custom properties.

## Typography

9 styles from `core.typography`. `fontFamily` is the first family of each stack; the full stacks, and properties DESIGN.md has no field for (text case, decoration), are in tokens.json. Families: Mackinac, Matter.

### Fonts (from README.md)

Marketing loads Matter (weights 300 to 700) and Mackinac (P22 Mackinac Pro, weights 400, 500, 700) from `/fonts/*.woff2` on www.sharewillow.com. The login app loads Matter 100 to 900, including italics, from `/fonts/Matter/`, and computes the display face as `p22-mackinac-pro`. Both faces are licensed to ShareWillow. Tokens name them. The style guide uses `ui-sans-serif` and `Georgia`.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.

### What to distrust (from README.md)

The hero and footer palette on the light page is the `light.band` group. It was a `dark` token set, but the site did not switch themes, so it is not registered as a theme. Hover and pressed colours are stylesheet rules (`espresso/90`, `ivory`, `scale: 0.985`), not a hovered element. The marketing focus ring was declared as `ring-espresso/30` and was not forced. Keyboard focus on Product painted the browser outline `auto 1px rgb(229, 151, 0)`. The login checkbox was already checked, so the unchecked fill is missing. Display sizes that use `clamp()` are recorded at 1440, not at 390. Matter and Mackinac are proprietary and are not in this package. The style guide falls back to system fonts.

### Do and don't (from README.md)

- **Espresso does the asking, lemon marks the exception.** Primary buttons are `#180600` pills. Lemon `#faf082` is the accent chip and the occasional button, with espresso ink on it.
- **Display is Mackinac, UI is Matter.** Headlines use the serif at weight 500 and tight tracking. Labels, nav, and buttons stay in Matter.
- **Pills for actions, 24 and 32 for surfaces.** Buttons and nav links are fully rounded. Menu and pricing cards use 24px or 32px.
- **One light page, with a dark footer.** Do not invent a dark theme. The dark band is `#0d0a07` with `#f5f2e0` ink.
- **Leave the app alone.** Login is a second palette (`#1a1a1a` on white, blue links). Do not mix it into the marketing ivory page.
